spots.name: Sugarloaf Mountain
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 1,042 m (3,419 ft).

spots.name: Black Dome
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 640 m (2,100 ft).

spots.name: Granite Wash Pass
spots.tip: A mountain pass: easy high ground by car. Fog often fills the valleys on either side at sunrise; check winter road conditions.

spots.name: Painted Rock Dam
spots.tip: eBird birding hotspot with 242 species recorded. Birds are most active in the first two hours after sunrise; recent sightings at ebird.org/hotspot/L292865.

spots.name: Natural Arch
spots.tip: A natural arch. Low side light at either end of the day brings out the rock texture; at night it can frame the Milky Way.
